body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 3 units along a wall, floor or rough ceiling, ending on a supporting surface.

surges.html: An ordinary restraint that prevents this movement is suppressed until the movement ends.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Pads (upkeep 0): climb walls at normal Movement while at least two limbs are available; a ceiling requires an extra 1 unit per space.
